title: ARGONAUT – E-Pump Switch Box (ESB)
description:
This ITT is a re-issue of ITT 25.OHBB.004, for which there was no selection. For this re-issue of the ITT, specification requirements have been updated.

OHB System AG, a subsidiary of the European space and technology group OHB SE, is acting as subcontractor to Thales Alenia Space (TAS-I) who has been contracted by the European Space Agency (ESA) as prime Contractor for the realization of the ARGONAUT Lunar Descent Element (LDE). Under its subcontract, OHB is responsible for the EPS, TT&C and GNC subsystems up to flight readiness. 
The objective of the present procurement is the selection of the subcontractor for the 3 x Argonaut E-pump Switch Box (ESB). As part of the Argonaut LDE system one ESB shall provide the functionality of distribution and protection of electrical power to two Pumps (connected to one main engine) during all mission phases.
As a high-power protection equipment, the ESB should be designed to sustain an average power throughput of 15.6 kW and to handle a transient of 180A (TBC) including margin for 0.5 s per output lines while providing discrete telemetry to the PCDU. 
The procurement of the ESB will be conducted in line with the “ESA Best Practices for the Selection of Subcontractors by Prime Contractors in the frame of ESA’s Major Procurements” (reference ESA BEST PRACTICES IPC(2012)65, rev.2).
Notwithstanding the complete list of countries identified in the Special Provision for visibility purposes, the ITT letter of invitation will contain a dedicated set of geographical return requirements/targets to be considered.

title: Virtuelle Rekonstruktion Watteau-Kabinett
description: Virtuelle Rekonstruktion von Kulturliegenschaften: Entwicklung einer App mit interaktiven 3D-Modellen zum Watteau-Kabinett im Barockschloss Bruchsal. Bei der Entwicklung der 3D-App ist insbesondere darauf zu achten, dass das Framework der Features und die Verbindungen zum 3D-Modell generisch anzulegen sind, damit sie als Gerüst für die Nutzung bei anderen Kulturliegenschaften dienen können. Das virtuelle Modell soll zum Ausgangspunkt und zur Schnittstelle der Datenabfrage genutzt werden. Im Modell sind Verbindungen zu verorten, die eine Abfrage in unterschiedlichen Menüs zu verschiedenen Wissensgebieten ermöglichen. Eine Verortung des Besucherstandorts über satellitengesteuerte Erfassung des individuellen Endgeräts ist vorzusehen. Diese Orientierungshilfe soll dem Anwender zugleich die Möglichkeit bieten, das Modell in Echtzeit zu durchlaufen, so als wäre seine direkte Umgebung das rekonstruierte Modell. Daneben muss die App weitere verschiedene Ansichten, wie Vogelperspektive und Draufsicht bieten. Ein Switch zum real existierenden photogrammetrischen Modell sowie zu verschiedenen zeitlichen Ebenen ist für den Vergleich zu historischen Zuständen einzuplanen. Weitere zu entwickelnde Features, sind beispielsweise neben interaktiven Einzelmodellen auch die Möglichkeit eines Switchs zu Bilddokumenten, die als Quelle die Art der Rekonstruktion erklären sowie Vertiefungsmenüs zu den Inhalten. Der Auftraggeber beabsichtigt den erfolgreichen Bieter mit weiteren Leistungen der virtuellen Rekonstruktion verschiedener (Teil-)Objekte der Kulturliegenschaften der Staatlichen Schlösser und Gärten Baden-Württemberg zu beauftragen. Es handelt sich hierbei um Einzelabrufe zwischen voraussichtlich 50.000,00 € und 500.0000,00 € bei voraussichtlich 1 bis 3 Objekten jährlich.

title: Direct Electron Detector
description: The University of Groningen (UG) intends to purchase a new direct electron detector to upgrade the existing Thermo Fisher Scientific Talos Arctica 200 kV transmission cryogenic electron microscope for high-resolution data acquisition of individual proteins and their complexes. The new detector must be fully compatible with the existing microscope and will replace the combination of the current camera and the outdated energy filter. In addition, it should provide the option to be re-mounted after an energy filter to allow for a future upgrade. The detector must enable high-speed data collection while preserving full temporal and spatial resolution. This purchase is carried out in the framework of the ERC Starting Grant “Actin in Action”. The research group Membrane Enzymology will use the upgraded microscope to study the molecular basis of actin-based motility of human pathogens. These samples are biochemically challenging, heterogeneous, and often available only in limited quantities. To obtain high-resolution cryogenic electron microscopy data, the detector must combine maximal acquisition speed, reproducibility, and image quality. The upgrade will ensure that the Talos Arctica microscope is capable of delivering cutting-edge data necessary to answer the scientific questions defined in the grant and to serve the broader user community within the Faculty of Science and Engineering and UMCG.

description: Saaremaa rannajärvede kudetingimuste taastamise eeluuringud. Valminud eeluuringute ja koostatud tehniliste lahenduste alusel peab olema võimalik tellida konkreetsete tööde läbiviimine koos projekteerimisega. Töö eesmärgiks on läbi viia siirdekalade rännete PIT telemeetria uuring ning topo-geodeetilised ja ehitusgeoloogilised tööd, et selgitada välja, kas ja kuidas oleks võimalik parenda Järveküla järve kudeala. Vajalik on analüüsida erinevaid variante kudemisvõimaluste parandamiseks ning anda esialgne hinnang niisuguse mastaapse projekti muudele mõjudele. Eeluuringu käigus kogutud andmed on aluseks edasistele projekteerimistöödele. Eeluuringu I eesmärk on hinnata kõikide Lääne-Saaremaal paiknevate Kihelkonna lahe rannikuveega piirnevate rannajärvede potentsiaal mageveekalade koelmualadena. Eeluuringu II eesmärk on valida välja parendamistöödeks kõige kõrgema potentsiaaliga (sh kõige kuluefektiivsemad) rannajärved või muud siirdekalade koelmualad. Leida kohtspetsiifiline lahendus iga taastootmisala parendamiseks. Selleks tuleb muuhulgas läbi viia topo-geodeetilised uuringud ja insenertehnilised arvutused kavandatava tehnilise teostatavuse hindamiseks. Eeluuringu käigus kogutud andmed ja esitatud ettepanekud on aluseks edaspidistele projekteerimistöödele.

title: ESCA - SPANISH COMPONENT OF THE ATLANTIC CONSTELLATION
description: The purpose of this procurement, carried out in open competition, is the development (up and until final acceptance) of the SpanishComponent of the Atlantic Constellation composed by: a ready to be flown and qualified for operation' Flight Segment, composed by small earth observation satellites with a minimum set of 4 payloads ( i.e. multispectral optical payload, GNSS/R, AIS/VDES and IoT, with the possibility for the tenderers to propose additional payloads as an option to improve the future exploitation of the constellation) and Ground Segment (FOS, PDGS and Marketplace plus all the required ancillaries). Launch and operations of the constellation are explicitly excluded from the scope and objectives of this procurement, while compatibility with several European launchers, accommodation and orbit injection analysis as well as operations preparations up to Final Acceptance Review shall be considered for the proposal preparation. Subject to good quality of received proposal(s), a contract might be placed with a Spanish Prime Contractor.Therefore, the present ITT is addressed to Spanish economic operators having their registered office in Spain and acting as Prime Contractors. ESA shall consider for evaluation only proposals from Spanish entities at Prime Contractor level. In addition, specific industrial policy measures will be implemented to maximise the involvement of Spanish economic operators. The resulting Contract will encompass two (2) contractual Phases as follows: Phase 1 devoted to development and delivery of the first satellite and the associated Ground Segment up to their Final Acceptance Review and Phase 2 devoted to development and delivery of the additional recurring satellites and the associated delta Ground Segment activities up to Final Acceptance Review of the entire constellation. The Agency will reserve the right not to proceed with Phase 2. The procurement will be carried out on the basis of ESA's regulations [in particular, the ESA Procurement Regulations (ESA/REG/001, rev. 5) and the General Clauses and Conditions for ESA Contracts (ESA/REG/002, rev. 3)].
